capperSportRecords.source: Settled public sports trades only (scanner history + $500+ backfill). Records are never invented. Sample under 10 is flagged small; Best at and sport-weighted ranking need 5+ settled bets in that sport.

provenPicks.rule: Elite: 30+ graded BIG bets (stake >= max($500, 1.5x median)) over a 60+ day account, +15% big-bet ROI, Hot, and +20% ROI in the sport (+10% if 100+ graded). No 12-bet small-sample path. Fun/small bets are ignored. A pick is only GOOD if that capper has 30+ graded in that sport. Every pick needs $500+. Market makers/bots dropped. One-off jackpot records cannot be elite. Picks 2c+ worse than the whale entry (after Kalshi fee) are hidden. Buys older than 1 hour are tagged stale. Split games hidden.
